retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, distorted portrait framed within a glowing CRT television screen, featuring vibrant analog color bleeds and thin horizontal scanlines.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, square composition centered on a curved television screen displaying a heavily distorted, high-contrast human silhouette. The image is characterized by warm orange and red glows clashing with cool blue horizontal light streaks, simulating analog signal interference and phosphor burn-in.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed within a secondary internal border (the TV screen)
Horizontal light streaks intersecting a vertical silhouette
High-contrast dark foreground against a luminous, textured background
coreInvariants: Curved corners on the inner frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large, central silhouette occupying the majority of the inner screen frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright orange-yellow glow on the left side of the screen.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye follows the horizontal blue line across the top, then drops into the distorted facial features of the silhouette.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black border surrounding the central screen element.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark shadows provide the foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange and fiery red create the internal glow.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Electric blue horizontal lines and cyan highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation within the screen area; extremely low value in the surrounding frame.

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed above a thin horizontal divider line

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Color-coding different words within the same typeface family to distinguish hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rule separating text from image
Circular emblem in the top right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 80s aesthetic and clean uppercase forms.
Provides the correct period-accurate geometric feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark square image featuring a curved CRT television screen. Inside the screen, show a distorted, high-contrast silhouette of a person's head. Use a palette of deep blacks, fiery oranges, and a sharp horizontal blue light streak. Apply a visible scanline texture and analog noise.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thin blue horizontal line near the top. Above the line, place two words in a clean, uppercase geometric sans-serif font. The first word should be red, the second white and italicized. Add a small circular logo icon at the far right of the line.

verificationChecks: Does the text sit above a thin horizontal line?
Is the color palette dominated by orange and black?
Is the silhouette distorted by horizontal light artifacts?

adjustableVariables: Color of the horizontal light streak
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the image looks like a physical screen capture.
Verify the text is legible despite the wide tracking.
Check that the blue horizontal line spans the width of the inner frame.
Confirm the presence of chromatic aberration on the edges of the silhouette.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a distorted analog video portrait with minimalist geometric typography separated by a single horizontal rule.
